fields.description: Code the user wishes to assign to this plan. It is intended to hold the industry standard ID for this plan. User entered.

fields.description: User selects plan class code. Plan class codes are defined in the LookupCode table for the lookup type 'PlanClass'. Codes for lookup type 'PlanClass' are user definable.

fields.description: Patient deductible amount. User entered.

fields.description: Age in days at which charges billed to the guarantor are transferred to the collections system. User entered.

fields.name: CollectionPriority
fields.description: Level to be assigned to this account and responsible party when the account is moved into collections.

fields.name: ProfileOverrideAllowed
fields.description: The plan override allowed flag indicates if a plans payment profiles may be overridden at the provider level. Acceptable values are (Y)es or (N)o.

fields.name: RecordStatus
fields.description: User selected record status for the finance center. RecordStatus is defined in the LookupCode table for the lookup type 'RecordStatus'. Codes for lookup type 'RecordStatus' are not user definable. Valid codes are (A)ctive and (I)nactive.

fields.description: User ID of user that created the record.

fields.name: PrimaryOnlyEMC
fields.description: Flag indicating the plan accepts claims electronically only when the plan is billed as the primary plan. Possible values are (Y)es or (N)o. NOTE: This field will be obsolete for 6.00.00. It was being overloaded for two values. BillableEMCCoverage and UnbalancedRemit are replacing PrimaryOnlyEMC.

fields.name: ClaimMemberIDLabel
fields.description: Label for the Claim Member ID field as set by the practice for the plan.

fields.name: EDIMemberIDLabel
fields.description: Label for the EDI Member ID field as set by the practice for the plan.

fields.name: DNZip
fields.description: Denormalized Zip code from Address table.

fields.name: ImportPlanID
fields.description: Unique identifier that links the plan to the system maintained plan list.

fields.name: FormularyPlanID
fields.description: Formulary Plan ID that is used by the plan.

fields.name: BillablePlan
fields.description: Indicates if the plan has all the necessary information for billing. Possible values: (Y)es, (N)o.

fields.name: EDIMemberIDEnable
fields.description: User entered - Flag that will enable the EDI (Eligibility) member ID 2 field on the UI. Valid values are determined by the Confirmation lookuptype (Y/N).

fields.name: ClaimMemberID2Enable
fields.description: User entered - Flag that will enable the claim member ID 2 field on the UI. Valid values are determined by the Confirmation lookuptype (Y/N).

fields.name: ClaimMemberID2Label
fields.description: User entered - Label for the Claim Member ID 2 field.

fields.name: ClaimMemberID2Qual
fields.description: User Entered. ANSI Qualifier for 2nd Claim member ID field on policy. Validated by the mentioned lookup type. Field is supported by the lookup types:[ANISI2ndClaimQID]. Values are defined in the LookupCode table for the above lookup types.

fields.name: FilingCode
fields.description: User Entered. It is used to populate the SBR09 ANSI field. Validated by the mentioned lookup type. Field is supported by the lookup types:[ClaimCode]. Values are defined in the LookupCode table for the above lookup types.

fields.name: DenialMsgCodeProfileID
fields.description: FK - From ERSMsgCodeProfile table. User entered profile name to indicate which denial list the plan uses.

fields.name: PayerID
fields.description: FK - Payer.

fields.name: SplitEMCSecAllowed
fields.description: This field indicates if secondary split claims are allowed to bill electronically. Lookup type "Confirmation" will be used to set its value (Y/N).

fields.name: BillableEMCCoverage
fields.description: This field describes what the max coverage order of a coverage that is allowed to be billed electronically for this plan. 1 means that only primary may be billed electronically, 2 means that only secondary may be billed electronically and 3 means tertiary and above may be billed electronically. Note that this field is derived in plan maintenance and isn't the UI's values.

fields.name: UnbalancedRemit
fields.description: This flag specifies how this plan handles unbalanced remittance when applicable. Values come from UnbalancedClaimsAction lookup.

name: Procedure
description: This table is used to define the procedure codes.

fields.name: ProcedureCode
fields.description: Procedure code which represents a procedure performed. User entered.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: User selected procedure class code. Procedure class codes are defined in the LookupCode table for the lookup type 'ProcedureClass'. Codes for the lookup type 'ProcedureClass' are user definable.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Description for the procedure code. User entered.

fields.name: Sex
fields.description: User selected sex. Sex codes are defined in the LookupCode table for the lookup type 'GenderClass'. Codes for the lookup type 'GenderClass' are not user definable. Acceptable values are (M)ale only, (F)emale only, or (B)oth.

fields.name: Visit
fields.description: The visit flag indicates if the procedure must be part of an encounter with the provider. Possible values are (Y)es or (N)o.

fields.name: UBCode
fields.description: UB Code for the procedure code. User selected.

fields.name: TOSCode
fields.description: Type of service code for the procedure. User selected.

fields.name: DepartmentCode
fields.description: Department code for the procedure. User selected.

fields.name: CertNumber
fields.description: User entered certification number for the procedure. Certification numbers are defined in the LookupCode table for the lookup type 'CertNumber'. Codes for the lookup type 'CertNumber' are not user definable. Certification numbers are stored as character.

fields.name: PostMethod
fields.description: User selected post method. Acceptable values are (S)tandard, (A)nesthesia, (E)nteral, (P)arenteral, (M)onthly Rental, (D)aily Rental, (O)xygen, (T)ime, or (I)nventory Units.

fields.name: PostFactor
fields.description: Post factor which adjusts amount of charge for the procedure. User entered.

fields.name: EMCBillable
fields.description: EMC billable indicator is set to (Y)es if the procedure code may be billed electronically, (N)o otherwise.

fields.name: Justification
fields.description: Justification indicator is set to (Y)es if the procedure code may be billed but requres justification, (N)o otherwise.

fields.name: CollapseMode
fields.description: System defined. User entered collapse mode. Validated by the mentioned lookup type. Field is supported by the lookup types:[ProcCollapseMode]. Values are defined in the LookupCode table for the above lookup types.

fields.name: UBSortPriority
fields.description: User entered sort priority for the procedure. Valid values are 1 - 9 and stored as character.

fields.name: GLSubAcct
fields.description: User entered general ledger sub account number. The sub-account is 3 characters.

fields.name: Taxable
fields.description: User enters taxable code to indicate the procedure code is taxable. Taxable codes are defined in the LookupCode table for the lookup type 'Confirmation'. Codes for the lookup type 'Confirmation' are not user definable. Acceptable values are (Y)es and (N)o.

fields.name: ValidateDiagStatus
fields.description: System defined. User set mode of procedure/diagnosis validation. Field is supported by the lookup types:[ProcDiagValidate]. Values are defined in the LookupCode table for the above lookup types.

fields.name: PlanRejectStatus
fields.description: User set mode which determines the status of insurance plan rejections. Possible values are: (A) - Active , (I) - Inactive Codes are validated by the lookup type ProcPlanReject.

fields.name: Keywords
fields.description: User entered keywords which may be used to locate a procedure code.

fields.name: RecordStatus
fields.description: User selected record status for the procedure code. RecordStatus is defined in the LookupCode table for the lookup type 'RecordStatus'. Codes for lookup type 'RecordStatus' are not user definable. Valid codes are (A)ctive and (I)nactive.

fields.name: TimeStamp
fields.description: System generated date/time stamp record was last written.

fields.name: LastUser
fields.description: User ID of user that last wrote the record.

fields.name: CreateStamp
fields.description: System generated date/time stamp record was created.

fields.name: CreateUser
fields.description: User ID of user that created the record.

fields.name: BillingClass
fields.description: User entered. The billing class of the procedure will determine how the procedure is handled during the billing process. Field is supported by the lookup types:[ProcBillingClass]. Values are defined in the LookupCode table for the above lookup types.

fields.name: EAPageSID
fields.description: System generated identifier. Use the General Sequence to obtain the SID.

fields.name: ConcurrencyExempt
fields.description: When PostMethod is 'A', and ConcurrencyExempt is N, Anesthesia concurrency numbers are tracked.

fields.name: MUQualifyingVisit
fields.description: Marks the procedure as indicating a face to face visit i.e. MU qualifying visit.

fields.name: VisitType
fields.description: System defined. Field is supported by the lookup types:[ProcedureVisitType]. Values are defined in the LookupCode table for the above lookup types.

fields.name: UDSQualifyingVisit
fields.description: UDS Qualifying Visit flag.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: Date the procedure became effective.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: Date the procedure is no longer effective.

fields.description: AETitle provided by PACS system at time the image was read.

fields.name: PACSInbModalityType

fields.description: Timestamp indicating date/time study was marked Read.

fields.name: ReadStatus
fields.description: For Radiology Desktop, indicates status of study with respect to radiologist. Possible Values are: U - Unread F - Forward O - Over read C - Completed

fields.name: ReadStatusStamp
fields.description: Timestamp indicating date/time when readstatus was last changed.

fields.name: ImageCount
fields.description: Count of total images for the study. Partially denormalized field - maintained by write triggers on Document and Image tables.

fields.name: SeriesCount
fields.description: Count of total series for the study. Partially denormalized field - maintained by write triggers on Document and Image tables.

fields.name: HL7Updated
fields.description: Flags the RISStudy when the inbound ORU updates it, so that outbound won't pick up the change and send it out again (then it will reset it back). Valid Values: Y/N

fields.name: ImageAcquiredStamp
fields.description: This is the TimeStamp that the images were acquired.

fields.name: ImageType
fields.description: This field conveys the type of images that were acquired derived off the system defined Lookup code with LookupType "RISImageType". Possible Values: F - Film D - Digital can be blank.

fields.name: PACSOutAETitle
fields.description: AETitle provided by modality rules system at time the study was created or updated. Represents how HL7 sent the ORU out to the PACS.

fields.name: PACSOutModalityType
fields.description: Indicates type of modality. Provided by modality rules system at time the study was created or updated. Represents how HL7 sent the ORU out to the PACS.

fields.name: DNPACSModalityType
fields.description: Denormalized field based first off PACSInbModalityType. If not entered, PACSOutModalityType is stored in this field. This field is used by the radiology navigator to show radiologists which modality the study is from. Trigger maintains value of this field.

fields.name: DNScheduledDate
fields.description: Date scheduled. Maintained by DB triggers. Unknown for Ordered studies. Uses create date on appointment. If no appointment, then uses create date on encounter. Otherwise, this is unknown.

fields.name: DNScheduledUser
fields.description: User scheduled. Maintained by DB triggers. Unknown for Ordered studies. Uses create user on appointment. If no appointment, then uses create user on encounter. Otherwise, this is unknown.

fields.name: AUCModifier
fields.description: G-Code modifier indicating if Appropriate Use was followed

fields.name: AUCSessionID
fields.description: Clinical Decision Support Mechanism (CDSM) SessionID
